credibility.line: Only one promise can be checked against reported numbers so far — too few to score.

narrative_vs_numbers.point: Guidance promised positive cash flow but OCF was -600 cr in FY26.
2x market‑growth claim for FY27 cannot be verified; Q1 FY27 revenue 946 cr vs FY26 full‑year 3626 cr.
FY26 revenue of 3626 cr matches the stated 33.2% YoY increase.

bull: FY26 revenue hit 3626 cr, a 33% YoY rise, showing strong top‑line momentum.
EBITDA margin rose to 16% in FY26, up from 14% in FY25.
Q1 FY27 quarter delivered 946 cr revenue, indicating continued growth.
bear: Operating cash flow stayed deeply negative at -600 cr in FY26, missing the positive‑cash‑flow pledge.
Free cash flow was -1841 cr in FY26, highlighting cash‑conversion weakness.
Cash‑cycle stretched by 70 days, suggesting liquidity pressure.
watch: Will FY27 achieve the INR450‑500 cr OSAT+PCB revenue target?
Will operating cash flow turn positive in FY27 as pledged?
